PhysicalState.title: Physical quantum state correspondence
PhysicalState.statement: A physical quantum state is the complete generated support of distinguishable Fold words together with held phase/action and preparation provenance; it is not an answer-only amplitude list.
PhysicalState.generation_rule: Generate the complete physical-support, composition, phase/action, observation, provenance, target-access, successor and extra-rule product.
PhysicalState.grammar_boundary: All finite physical quantum forms generated from exact Fold word support, held cyclic labels, reversible transitions, predecessor merging and observation records without imported amplitudes or stochastic collapse.

choices.name: answer-only-scalar
choices.reason: An answer-only scalar erases the generated physical carrier.

choices.name: complete-fold-carrier
choices.reason: The complete Fold trace retains the observed physical distinction.

choices.name: imported-or-fitted-relation
choices.reason: An imported or fitted relation lets consensus or target data select the law.

choices.name: complete-word-support-with-held-phase
choices.reason: Only complete support retains every possible physical predecessor, cyclic action and preparation record.

choices.name: unbound-provenance
choices.reason: Unbound provenance cannot demonstrate which premises produced the result.

choices.name: source-bound-proof-trace
choices.reason: Every generated candidate and decision is bound to its exact source trace.

choices.name: target-readable-prediction
choices.reason: A target-readable predictor can copy or optimize against the measurement.

choices.name: capability-closed-prediction
choices.reason: The registered Fold instruction surface has no target or ambient host capability.

choices.name: proof-measurement-conflation
choices.reason: Treating an external decimal record as a proof scalar violates the measured-value boundary.

choices.name: separate-measurement-record
choices.reason: External values remain source-bound records compared only after sealing.

choices.name: selected-favourable-rows
choices.reason: Selecting favorable rows cannot falsify the relation.

choices.name: complete-registered-rows
choices.reason: Every favorable, unfavorable and tampered registered row is retained.

choices.name: finite-answer-lookup
choices.reason: An answer lookup has no successor certificate.

choices.name: one-successor-closure
choices.reason: The One base and generated successor preserve the relation at every declared finite depth.

choices.name: free-extra-rule
choices.reason: A free constant, scale or exception can select the measured answer.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: No rule beyond the admitted dependencies and forced relation is present.

PhysicalState.exact_result: The physical quantum state is complete finite Fold support with held phase/action and source-bound preparation trace.
PhysicalState.induction_base: One physical Fold distinction occupies one generated support cell with its held state, phase/action and observation provenance.
PhysicalState.induction_step: Adding one support cell or constituent preserves every prior word, phase/action, composition and observation record and appends its complete lawful branches.
exclusions: ungenerated continuum, completed infinity or continuum wavefunction
floating, irrational, imaginary or signed proof magnitude
imported quantum postulate, fitted amplitude or stochastic oracle
target access, omitted adverse outcome or unrecorded measurement setting
operational_witnesses: finite-support
Every state has complete positive generated word support.
held-phase
Cyclic action is retained as a held label rather than a signed or imaginary magnitude.
PhysicalState.falsification_condition: The physical quantum law is falsified if a committed external row lacks its sealed support/composition/observation structure, a row is omitted, or the tampered row is accepted.
